gl:definition.gl:content: deterministic, registered and legally cited view of the testimonial record of a governed digital twin, computed under a profile from the event-sourced change log

gl:notes.gl:content: The passport is the legal materialized view of the twin; the twin is the source of truth.
Notarized snapshots support as-of queries, which answer what was legally true at a given time.
Any conforming twin can emit the view; the projection is defined representation-neutrally.
